meta.title: TrickBook - Track Tricks. Find Spots. Ride Together.
meta.description: TrickBook is the free app for skaters, snowboarders, and action sports riders to track tricks, discover spots, and connect with the community. Download now on iOS and Android.
meta.keywords: skateboarding app, trick tracker, skate spots, snowboarding app, action sports, trick list, skateboard progress, find skate spots
meta.ogDescription: The free app for action sports riders to track tricks, discover spots, and connect with the community.

hero.subline1: The action sports platform that doesn't sell you out.
hero.subline2: Track tricks. Find spots. Ride with real ones.

kaori.title: Ride smarter with <highlight>Kaori.</highlight>
kaori.description: Your always-on snowboard homie for real coaching, fresh trick ideas, and the push to keep progressing. Talk naturally, ask anything, or have her walk you through a trick on the spot.
kaori.userMessage: I finally landed frontside 360s. What should I learn next?
kaori.reply: That's huge. Since your front 3 is solid, let's build toward a frontside 540. I'll break down the setup, takeoff, and landing—and we can start with the first progression now.
kaori.voiceHint: Kaori can talk you through it

features.title: Everything you need to progress
features.subtitle: Built by riders who wanted a better way to track their journey.

track.title: Track
track.subtitle: Every trick you land
track.description: Build custom trick lists for any sport. Check off tricks as you land them, track your sessions, and watch your skills grow over time.

progress.title: Progress
progress.subtitle: See how far you've come
progress.description: Visual progress tracking shows your journey from beginner to pro. Browse the Trickipedia to discover new tricks and set goals for your next session.

connect.title: Connect
connect.subtitle: Ride with your crew
connect.description: Find and follow riders who share your stoke. Share clips, message your homies, and build a community around the sports you love.

testimonials.title: Riders are stoked
testimonials.subtitle: Hear from the community that makes TrickBook what it is.

quotes.jake: Finally an app built by skaters, for skaters. I've been tracking my progress for months and it's actually motivating to see how many tricks I've landed.
quotes.sarah: The spot finder is incredible. I moved to a new city and found three parks I didn't know about within my first week.
quotes.marcus: Love that this isn't just another social media app trying to sell my data. It's actually useful and respects my privacy.

step1.title: Download free
step1.description: Get TrickBook on iOS or Android. No credit card, no catch.

step2.title: Start tracking
step2.description: Create trick lists, discover spots near you, and log your sessions.

step3.title: Level up
step3.description: Watch your progress grow, connect with riders, and push your limits.

community.title: By Riders. <highlight>For Riders.</highlight>
community.description: Big tech platforms don't have our best interests at heart. Algorithms bury your content, and your attention is sold to advertisers. We built TrickBook because action sports communities deserve better.

point1.title: Your data stays yours
point1.text: Encrypted, private, never sold to advertisers.

point2.title: No algorithm games
point2.text: Your content reaches your crew, not just who pays.

point3.title: Built by a small crew with big passion

community.quote: There's an intrinsic value in creating something for the sake of creating it.

finalCta.title: Stop scrolling. Start riding.
finalCta.subtitle: {{riders}}+ riders are already in. Free forever. No ads. No algorithm.
